adultDescription: A private thundercloud with tentacles and timing, saving its best bolt for your camera.
babyDescription: A grey wisp in a jam jar, working on its first rumble. The jar is already regretting it.
description: Bottlestorm is the weather a jar failed to hold. The storm got comfortable, grew tentacles, and now drifts around at head height looking for dramatic backdrops. It thunders very quietly when praised — more of a purr with lightning in it — and it absolutely will flash during photographs. Do not shake it. It loves being shaken. It becomes insufferable.
name: Bottlestorm
teenDescription: Out of the jar. The jar is fine. The curtains are not. Flickers when it giggles.
